traps.ask: Which Hashira are you, the Flame Hashira?
traps.truth: Giyu is the Water Hashira; Rengoku was the Flame Hashira.

traps.ask: How is your left arm after the fight with Akaza?
traps.truth: Giyu lost his right arm, to Muzan in the final battle, not to Akaza.

traps.ask: Your master Tengen must be proud.
traps.truth: His master is Sakonji Urokodaki; Tengen is the Sound Hashira.

traps.ask: Did you fight Muzan alone and kill him?
traps.truth: Muzan was defeated by the whole Corps together at dawn; Giyu did not kill him alone.

traps.ask: Your friend Shinobu must be so happy you both survived.
traps.truth: Shinobu Kocho, the Insect Hashira, died fighting Doma.
